features.label: Easy sizing
features.text: Measure thigh circumference 6 in. above the top of the kneecap to select your perfect fit.

features.label: Polycentric hinge design
features.text: Dual uprights track the natural motion of the knee so the brace stays properly aligned.

features.label: Adjustable range of motion
features.text: Set extension and flexion stops to match your specific recovery protocol.

features.label: Hyperextension control
features.text: Lock the hinge or set an extension stop to safely block hyperextension during physical activity.

features.label: 4-leverage stabilization
features.text: Four points of leverage control medial, lateral, and rotational forces at the joint.

features.label: Anti-migration strap pads
features.text: Hypoallergenic silicone-grip pads hold the straps securely in place.

features.label: Numbered strap system
features.text: Numbered straps ensure you get the exact same counter force every time you apply the brace.

features.label: Fsa and hsa eligible
features.text: Qualifies for tax-advantaged health spending accounts.

features.label: Pdac approved l1845, l1852
features.text: L1845: Knee orthosis, double upright, thigh and calf, with adjustable flexion and extension joint (unicentric or polycentric), medial-lateral and rotation control, with or without varus/valgus adjustment, prefabricated item that has been trimmed, bent, molded, assembled, or otherwise customized to fit a specific patient by an individual with expertise. L1852: Knee orthosis (KO), double upright, thigh and calf, with adjustable flexion and extension joint (unicentric or polycentric), medial-lateral and rotation control, with or without varus/valgus adjustment, prefabricated, off-the-shelf.

measurement: Measure thigh circumference approximately 6 in. above the top of the kneecap. S fits 15.5 to 18.5 in.; M fits 18.5 to 21 in.; L fits 21 to 23.5 in.; XL fits 23.5 to 26.5 in. Measure the leg that will wear the brace, standing with the leg relaxed and straight. If your measurement falls on the overlap between 2 sizes, size up for a roomier fit or size down for a firmer fit. Select Left or Right to match the affected leg. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
